Epic.Objective: Caleb Ward must transform from a discarded, powerless maintenance worker into the leader of a cohesive, powerful unit of outcasts, ultimately exposing the truth that summoned heroes are sacrifices and breaking the cycle of exploitation in Avarra.
Epic.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb and his bonded companions have defeated the immediate threats posed by the kingdom's rival heroes and the monsters of the frontier; the true nature of the summoning ritual (feeding an ancient power) is publicly revealed or irrefutably proven; Caleb has established a stable, voluntary bond network that functions as a strategic asset, proving that trust-based power surpasses domination-based power.
Epic.InitialPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
Epic.FirstMilestone: Caleb is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

LongChildren.Objective: Caleb must survive the kingdom's rejection and the hostile frontier environment by forming his first voluntary bonds with outcast individuals, establishing the foundational mechanics of Concord and securing his immediate survival.
LongChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has formed stable, voluntary bonds with at least two of the designated outcast companions (the disgraced knight, elven sorceress, beastkin scout, or priestess); he has survived the initial monster attacks on the frontier; the kingdom has officially stripped him of support and declared him a failed hero; the bonded companions have begun to share fragments of their talents with Caleb, demonstrating the hidden strength of Concord.
LongChildren.InitialPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
LongChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

LongChildren.Objective: Caleb must integrate the remaining outcast companions into his group, navigating their individual traumas and distrust to build a cohesive unit capable of challenging stronger enemies and exploring forgotten dungeons.
LongChildren.ResolutionCriteria: All four designated outcast companions are actively bonded to Caleb and each other; the group has successfully conquered at least one forgotten dungeon or defeated a major monster threat; the internal dynamics of the group have stabilized, with trust replacing initial suspicion; the group has developed a distinct identity as a force capable of challenging the status quo.
LongChildren.InitialPhase: Caleb has survived the initial frontier dangers and formed bonds with at least two companions. The group is fragile, with unresolved tensions between members and limited understanding of Concord's full potential. They are operating on the fringes of society, lacking resources and a clear long-term strategy.
LongChildren.FirstMilestone: The group encounters a significant threat (a rival hero or a powerful monster) that forces them to rely on their combined bonded abilities, leading to a pivotal victory that cements their unity and reveals the first clues about the true nature of the summoning ritual.

LongChildren.Objective: Caleb must uncover and expose the conspiracy behind the summoning ritual, confronting the ancient power beneath the kingdoms and the rival heroes sent to silence them, ultimately breaking the cycle of exploitation.
LongChildren.ResolutionCriteria: The truth about the summoning ritual (that heroes are fed to an ancient power) is revealed to the public or the relevant authorities; the rival heroes sent to silence the group are defeated or neutralized; Caleb and his companions have successfully challenged the source of the ancient power, breaking the cycle; Caleb has proven that freely given trust is the greatest power, achieving a new status as a true hero not by prophecy, but by unity.
LongChildren.InitialPhase: The group is a cohesive force with a growing reputation. They have gathered evidence of the kingdom's corruption and the true purpose of the summoning. They are facing increasing pressure from rival heroes and the kingdom's military, but they possess the knowledge and power to challenge the system.
LongChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb and his companions confront the leader of the rival heroes or the high priest of the Church, forcing a public revelation of the summoning ritual's true purpose, which triggers the final conflict against the ancient power.

MediumChildren.Objective: Caleb must survive his initial exile and form his first voluntary bond with an outcast companion, demonstrating the hidden strength of Concord and establishing his survival on the frontier.
MediumChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has formed a stable, voluntary bond with one of the designated outcast companions; he has survived the initial monster attacks on the frontier; the bonded companion has shared fragments of their talents with Caleb; the kingdom has officially stripped him of support and declared him a failed hero.
MediumChildren.InitialPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
MediumChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

MediumChildren.Objective: Caleb must form a second voluntary bond with another outcast companion, navigating their distrust and trauma to expand his network of shared talents and strengthen his position on the frontier.
MediumChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has formed a stable, voluntary bond with a second designated outcast companion; the group has survived a significant threat together; the second companion has shared fragments of their talents with Caleb and the first companion; the group's dynamics have begun to stabilize, with trust replacing initial suspicion.
MediumChildren.InitialPhase: Caleb has formed a bond with one companion and is surviving on the frontier. The group is fragile, with unresolved tensions and limited understanding of Concord's full potential. They are operating on the fringes of society, lacking resources and a clear long-term strategy.
MediumChildren.FirstMilestone: The group encounters a significant threat (a rival hero or a powerful monster) that forces them to rely on their combined bonded abilities, leading to a pivotal victory that cements their unity and reveals the first clues about the true nature of the summoning ritual.

MediumChildren.Objective: Caleb must form a third voluntary bond with another outcast companion, further expanding his network of shared talents and establishing the group as a cohesive unit capable of challenging stronger enemies.
MediumChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has formed a stable, voluntary bond with a third designated outcast companion; the group has successfully conquered at least one forgotten dungeon or defeated a major monster threat; the group's internal dynamics have stabilized, with trust replacing initial suspicion; the group has developed a distinct identity as a force capable of challenging the status quo.
MediumChildren.InitialPhase: Caleb has formed bonds with two companions and is operating as a small, fragile group on the frontier. They have survived initial threats but lack the cohesion and power to challenge larger enemies. They are gathering evidence of the kingdom's corruption but have not yet confronted the rival heroes or the Church directly.
MediumChildren.FirstMilestone: The group confronts a rival hero sent to silence them, using their combined bonded abilities to defeat or neutralize the threat, which reveals the first concrete evidence of the summoning ritual's true purpose and solidifies their resolve to uncover the truth.

ShortChildren.Objective: Caleb must face the kingdom's judgment for his 'useless' class and be sentenced to exile, establishing the initial conflict and his status as a failed hero.
ShortChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has been officially declared a failed hero by the kingdom's council; he has been stripped of all support and resources; he has been sentenced to be sent beyond the frontier as bait for monsters; he has left the kingdom's custody and is now on his own.
ShortChildren.InitialPhase: The story has not begun; no events described by the premise have occurred.
ShortChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb is summoned to the magical world of Avarra and undergoes the class determination ritual, where he is branded with the lowest-ranked class, Wayfarer, and granted the ability Concord.

ShortChildren.Objective: Caleb must survive his initial journey to the frontier and encounter his first outcast companion, offering them a bond and beginning the process of forming his first alliance.
ShortChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb has reached the frontier and survived the initial monster attacks; he has encountered one of the designated outcast companions; he has offered them a bond and they have accepted, forming their first voluntary connection; the companion has shared fragments of their talents with Caleb.
ShortChildren.InitialPhase: Caleb has been sentenced to exile and is traveling to the frontier. He is alone, with no allies, no weapons, and no knowledge of the frontier dangers. The outcast companions are currently in their respective states of disgrace, exile, or hiding, unaware of Caleb's existence.
ShortChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb encounters his first outcast companion (e.g., the disgraced knight) on the frontier, offers them a bond, and they accept, forming their first voluntary connection and demonstrating the hidden strength of Concord.

ShortChildren.Objective: Caleb and his first bonded companion must survive a significant threat together, proving the viability of their bond and establishing their survival on the frontier.
ShortChildren.ResolutionCriteria: Caleb and his first bonded companion have survived a significant threat (a rival hero or a powerful monster) together; they have relied on their combined bonded abilities to defeat or neutralize the threat; their bond has been tested and strengthened; they have established a base of operations or a safe haven on the frontier.
ShortChildren.InitialPhase: Caleb has formed a bond with one companion and is surviving on the frontier. The group is fragile, with unresolved tensions and limited understanding of Concord's full potential. They are operating on the fringes of society, lacking resources and a clear long-term strategy.
ShortChildren.FirstMilestone: Caleb and his first bonded companion encounter a significant threat (a rival hero or a powerful monster) that forces them to rely on their combined bonded abilities, leading to a pivotal victory that cements their unity and reveals the first clues about the true nature of the summoning ritual.
